description:
`ProfileSelector` is replaced by the package directory path it holds, because a selector carries no tag.

## Background

A `--profile` selector is a bare package directory path, with no `id:` or `path:` tag (`@/charter/D-18`). `ProfileSelector` (`crates/jit/src/commands/profile.rs:120`) is left with one variant holding that path. It is read by `crates/jit/src/commands/init.rs`, `crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs`, `crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs`, `crates/jit/src/main.rs`, `crates/jit/src/test_utils.rs`, `crates/jit/tests/cli_repo_workflow/profile_publication_tests.rs` and `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/derived_state_repair_tests.rs`. Line numbers are at the investigation baseline.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No `ProfileSelector` enum remains; each former use holds the package directory path.
- [hard] REQ-02: Selector parsing, its error for a tagged argument, and selection behave as before, shown by the existing profile CLI tests.
title: Make the profile selector a package path
